title: EFMP Special Needs Forum: Candy Cane Lane

sections.heading: EFMP Candy Cane Lane Special Needs Forum
sections.markdown:
EFMP is collaborating with the National Museum of the Marine Corps to host our semi-annual Special Needs Forum.

The forum will be held after-hours and allows families to connect with community resources, partners, and key stakeholders. During the event families will participate in holiday-themed games (Candy Cane Lane), crafts, picture with Santa, and have full access to the museum for a self-paced tour.

**Friday, December 11**  
**6:00-7:30 PM**

National Museum of the Marine Corps  
1775 Semper Fidelis Way, Triangle, VA 22172

[**Register on Eventbrite**](https://www.eventbrite.com/o/12865230600)
